crossRefs.note: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my…
I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

translations.web: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
translations.bsb: To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
translations.kjv: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
translations.asv: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
